name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '29' suffix is a meaningful domain ID, not Ghidra address residue: it is dispatch idx 0x29 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (sole xref to 0x34FF0 is DATA @ 0x51C35; idx = (0x51C35-0x51B91)/4 = 0x29), consistent with the _NN convention shared by every sibling (handler_27/_28/_2a). '__unref_drop' accurately reflects that no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot (unreferenced) and that its behaviour is a battle-item drop. No address residue.
purpose: Chapter-event dispatch handler idx 0x29 (unreferenced/cut-content tile-step drop beat): show dialog page 3, drop battle item id 0xD5 (冰之眼, the enter-hidden-chapter item) to the stepping char, then show dialog page 4.
logic_summary: Tile-step ABI handler (stepping_char_id = id of the char who stepped onto the trigger tile). Copies the inline 3-byte drop-entry blob data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_29_drop_entry_inline = {0x00, 0xD5, 0x00} (type 0 = ITEM pickup, little-endian uint16 value 0x00D5 = item id 0xD5) onto a 3-byte local, shows chapter-text dialog page 3, hands the local as a one-entry array to fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(stepping_char_id, 1, &blob), then shows chapter-text dialog page 4. Straight-line, no branch, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used (all three calls void-context). Order verified against disassembly @ 0x34FF0: blob copy (MOV ESI,0x52745; MOVSW+MOVSB) -> dialog page 3 (CALL 0x15F84) -> drop (CALL 0x1AA1D) -> page=4 prepushed then JMP 0x34FB7 into the borrowed display_dialog tail alt_43 hosted in fd2_chapter_event_handler_27; the borrowed tail is an in-binary code-folding artifact reproduced at Layer-2 as the inline page-4 dialog call.
